Further right, another light-skinned figure lies on the green ground, wrapped in a white shroud, with yellow and blue flat details suggesting vegetation and water.

In the background, a yellow sun rises or sets over a landscape with flat blue water and green land. The overall aesthetic employs bold black linework and minimal shading, characteristic of traditional block printing. The texture appears smooth and matte. The card has a flat light beige border.
